text:
ellie: heads up, sample app deploy to Cloudflare Workers failed in CI. stack: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: fs when importing @redwood/inference.
dom: ah that means the package is resolving the node entry in the runtime. Workers have no fs/Buffer. which import did you use?
ellie: just the normal `import {createClient} from '@redwood/inference'` in the example. bundler pulled node-utils.
nate: common pattern: we need a worker/browser ESM entry (dist/index.browser.mjs) and exports map so bundlers pick it. also avoid leaking Node types in d.ts.
sara: types failing too — TS expects NodeJS.ReadableStream. Workers use the DOM stream types. We need separate typing for node-only helpers.
dom: quick hack for sample app: import the browser entry directly: `import {createClient} from '@redwood/inference/dist/index.browser.mjs'` and polyfill randomBytes with crypto.getRandomValues. but that's just temporary.
ellie: patched util in app:
```js
function randHex(n){ const a=new Uint8Array(n); globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(a); return [...a].map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('') }
```
nate: long-term plan: 1) split browser/worker/node entrypoints, 2) move node-only helpers behind conditional dynamic imports, 3) audit d.ts for Node globals (Buffer/NodeJS.*).
sara: I'll run a grep for NodeJS|Buffer|fs in the repo and list leaks in the issue.
dom: small code pattern to avoid bundlers including node code: detect node and dynamic import: `const isNode = typeof process !== 'undefined' && !!process.versions?.node; const randomBytes = isNode ? async n => (await import('crypto')).randomBytes(n) : n => { const a=new Uint8Array(n); crypto.getRandomValues(a); return a }`
ellie: another gotcha: auth path clones Request and sends to a Node stream helper. Keep the shared path DOM-first.
devx-bot: ci-bot: created issue #1428 "worker-compatible sdk entry + types audit" and attached sample-app PR.
nate: propose v0.9.3 patch: - add dist/index.browser.mjs default for platforms with globalThis.fetch - move node helpers to dist/node - remove fs/Buffer from runtime core - fallback to getRandomValues if crypto.randomBytes missing. I'll draft the PR and add a CI job using wrangler to smoke-test a worker preview.
sara: will update typings PR in parallel.
ellie: thanks — once patch lands I'll revert our local hacks in the sample app. :thumbsup:
